```{r}
heights_data <- heights_data %>%
  mutate(height_numeric = as.numeric(height))

valid_heights <- heights_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(height_numeric) & height_numeric >= 40 & height_numeric <= 89)

ggplot(valid_heights, aes(x = height_numeric, fill = sex)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Density of Heights", x = "Height (inches)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
heights_data <- heights_data %>%
  mutate(cleaned_height = case_when(
    !is.na(height_numeric) & height_numeric >= 40 & height_numeric <= 89 ~ height_numeric,  
    !is.na(height_numeric) & height_numeric > 100 & height_numeric < 250 ~ height_numeric / 2.54,  
    TRUE ~ NA_real_ 
  ))

missing_table <- heights_data %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(missing_count = sum(is.na(cleaned_height)))

print(missing_table)

uncleaned_heights <- heights_data %>%
  filter(is.na(cleaned_height)) %>%
  select(height)

print(uncleaned_heights)
```

```{r}
valid_cleaned_heights <- heights_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(cleaned_height))

ggplot(valid_cleaned_heights, aes(x = cleaned_height, fill = sex)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Density Plot of Heights (After Cleaning)", x = "Height (inches)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#Problem 2
```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

load_citations <- function(file_path) {
  raw_data <- readLines(file_path, warn = FALSE)
  
  entry_start_idx <- grep("^@", raw_data)

  entry_types <- str_extract(raw_data[entry_start_idx], "(?<=@)\\w+")

  entry_ids <- str_extract(raw_data[entry_start_idx], "(?<=\\{)[^,]+")

  citations_list <- list()

  for (i in seq_along(entry_start_idx)) {
    start_idx <- entry_start_idx[i]
    end_idx <- ifelse(i < length(entry_start_idx), entry_start_idx[i + 1] - 1, length(raw_data))

    entry_lines <- raw_data[(start_idx + 1):end_idx]

    entry_lines <- gsub("[{}]", "", entry_lines)
    entry_lines <- trimws(entry_lines)

    key_value_pairs <- str_match(entry_lines, "^(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*(.+)")

    key_value_pairs <- key_value_pairs[!is.na(key_value_pairs[, 1]), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(key_value_pairs) > 0) {
      entry_data <- as.list(setNames(key_value_pairs[, 3], key_value_pairs[, 2]))
    } else {
      entry_data <- list()
    }

    entry_data$ID <- entry_ids[i]
    entry_data$Type <- entry_types[i]

    citations_list[[i]] <- as_tibble(entry_data, .name_repair = "unique")
  }

  citations_df <- bind_rows(citations_list) %>%
    select(ID, Type, title, author, journal, pages, year, publisher, volume, number) %>%  
    mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, "Unknown")))  

  return(citations_df)
}

file_path <-"/Users/manideeppendyala/Downloads/Citations.txt"

citations_data <- load_citations(file_path)

print(citations_data)
```
Part b
```{r}
convert_to_bibtex <- function(citation_row) {
  clean_field <- function(value) {
    if (!is.na(value) && value != "Unknown") {
      str_trim(gsub(",\\s*$", "", value)) 
    } else {
      NA
    }
  }

  title_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$title)
  author_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$author)
  journal_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$journal)
  pages_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$pages)
  publisher_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$publisher)
  volume_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$volume)
  number_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$number)
  year_clean <- clean_field(citation_row$year)

  bibtex_entry <- str_glue(
    "@{citation_row$Type}{{{citation_row$ID},\n",
    "  title={{{title_clean}}},\n",
    "  author={{{author_clean}}},\n",
    if (!is.na(journal_clean)) "  journal={{{journal_clean}}},\n" else "",
    if (!is.na(pages_clean)) "  pages={{{pages_clean}}},\n" else "",
    if (!is.na(publisher_clean)) "  publisher={{{publisher_clean}}},\n" else "",
    if (!is.na(volume_clean)) "  volume={{{volume_clean}}},\n" else "",
    if (!is.na(number_clean)) "  number={{{number_clean}}},\n" else "",
    "  year={{{year_clean}}}\n",
    "}}"
  )
  
  return(bibtex_entry)
}

first_book <- citations_data %>%
  filter(Type == "book") %>%
  slice(1)

if (nrow(first_book) > 0) {
  cat(convert_to_bibtex(first_book))
} else {
  cat("No books found")
}
```
#Problem 3
```{r}
top_residuals <- function(model, n = 5) {
  if (!inherits(model, "lm")) {
    stop("The input must be an lm.")
  }

  res <- residuals(model)

  total_residuals <- length(res)

  top_n_res <- res[order(abs(res), decreasing = TRUE)][1:n]

  return(top_n_res)
}
```
```{r}
data(mtcars)

mtcars.lm <- lm(mpg ~ disp, data = mtcars)

cat("Top 5 Residuals:\n")
print(paste("Residuals:", top_residuals(mtcars.lm)))

cat("\nTop 6 Residuals:\n")
print(paste("Residuals:", top_residuals(mtcars.lm, n = 6)))

cat("\nTesting with n = 40 :\n")
print(paste("Residuals:", top_residuals(mtcars.lm, n = 40)))
```

```{r}
compute_r2 <- function(df) {
  model <- lm(lifeExp ~ log10(gdpPercap), data = df)
  summary(model)$r.squared
}

r_squared <- gapminder %>%
  group_by(country, continent) %>%  
  nest() %>%  
  mutate(r_squared = map_dbl(data, compute_r2)) %>% 
  select(country, continent, r_squared)  

head(r_squared)
```
```{r}
ggplot(r_squared, aes(x = continent, y = r_squared, fill = continent)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "R-squared Values by Continent",
       x = "Continent",
       y = "R-squared of Life Expectancy Model") +
  theme_minimal()
```
